user.title: Set up heating system
user.description: One system per Home Assistant: one house with one heat source. Add heating circuits and rooms afterwards as sub-entries.

data_description.name: Name of the system, e.g. “Vienna”. Shown on the Heating page and in front of the entities.
data_description.manufacturer: How Heating Core talks to the heat source. Vaillant: setpoint to the zone (cloud, write budget). Ökofen: operating mode heat/setback plus offset, the Pellematic heating curve stays active. Other: any climate thermostat.

abort.already_configured: This heating system is already configured.

init.title: System settings

data.leitstand_expert: Expert log (full details of every run as notification)

init.description: Applies to the whole system. Set comfort and setback per circuit or room on its slider or on the Heating page.

data_description.eco_temp: Default setback for new heating circuits. Each circuit then has its own “Setback” slider.
data_description.away_temp: Used in the whole house while “Away” is active (switch, geofencing). Pre-heat overrides it.
data_description.min_trv_temp: Lower limit for all thermostats: frost protection, window open, summer.
data_description.hysteresis: How far the temperature may drift from the target before Heating Core reacts. Prevents constant switching. Typical: 0.5–0.8 °C.
data_description.budget_per_hour: Vaillant only: how many writes per hour to the boiler (cloud limit). Safety writes (window, emergency) don't count. Ökofen has no budget.
data_description.presence_activation_min: Presence must last this long before comfort is used. Filters people just passing through.
data_description.presence_deactivation_min: Comfort is kept for this long after the last presence.
data_description.window_delay_s: Setback only after the window has been open this long.
data_description.window_settle_s: Wait this long after closing before heating again – the sensor reads too cold right after.
data_description.pre_heat_timeout_min: Pre-heat switches itself off after this time at the latest.
data_description.away_entities: If any of these is on, the house is “Away” (e.g. input_boolean.global_away from geofencing). There is also the system's own Away switch.
data_description.guest_entity: Guests in the house: “Away” is ignored while this is on.
data_description.summer_entity: While on, heating rests: thermostats at minimum, Vaillant boiler off (hot water keeps running), switched back on afterwards.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Outdoor temperature for building compensation. Leave empty if unused.
data_description.weather_enabled: Raises the setpoint a little in cold weather, because walls and windows cool down. Not while away.
data_description.weather_zone3: Extra °C between 0 and +10 °C. No extra above.
data_description.boost_enabled: Faster heat-up: if a room is well below comfort, request more for a while. Better off with Ökofen (heating curve).
data_description.boost_threshold: Boost starts at this distance below comfort and ends when the room is nearly there.
data_description.humidity_enabled: Lowers the setpoint slightly at high humidity – humid air feels warmer.
data_description.humidity_drop: Drop in °C per 10 % humidity above 60 %, at most 2 °C.
data_description.push_enabled: Sends writes and new problems to phones. The problem notification in HA is always on.
data_description.notify_devices: Phones with the Home Assistant app that receive pushes.
data_description.quiet_schedule: While this schedule is on (e.g. at night), no pushes are sent.
data_description.leitstand_expert: After every run, all details (target, actual, decision, budget per circuit and room) as an HA notification. For troubleshooting.
data_description.room_demand_delta: Ökofen only: a room raises the whole circuit only when it is this far below its comfort. Otherwise it heats via its own thermostat and the boiler keeps running calmly. 0 = every room may raise it at once.
data_description.pre_heat_lead: Ökofen only: comfort starts this many hours before the schedule because the boiler is slow. The Heating page then shows “Pre-heating for …”. 0 = schedule applies exactly.
data_description.summer_mean_sensor: Statistics helper with the rolling 72 h mean of the outdoor temperature. If set and the summer switch is an input_boolean, Heating Core switches summer itself – only while writing is on. Empty = summer only by hand.
data_description.summer_limit: Summer from heating limit + 1.5 °C (72 h mean), heating season again below heating limit − 1.5 °C.

user.title: Heating circuit
user.description: A heating circuit is a branch with its own pump or setpoint at the heat source (e.g. radiators upstairs, floor heating).

data_description.name: Name of the circuit, e.g. “HC1 radiators upstairs”.
data_description.kind: Radiator or floor: circuit with a master thermostat at the heat source. Floor external: own pump and valves outside the heat source, released by boiler temperature.

reconfigure.title: Heating circuit
reconfigure.description: A heating circuit is a branch with its own pump or setpoint at the heat source (e.g. radiators upstairs, floor heating).

data_description.name: Name of the circuit, e.g. “HC1 radiators upstairs”.
data_description.kind: Radiator or floor: circuit with a master thermostat at the heat source. Floor external: own pump and valves outside the heat source, released by boiler temperature.

details.title: Heating circuit – devices
details.description: Devices and demand sources of the circuit. Set comfort and setback on its sliders afterwards.

data_description.master_climate: The zone or circuit at the heat source that receives the setpoint. Ökofen: on the Pellematic, switch this circuit's room sensor off (room influence 0) and eco mode off – otherwise it shuts the circuit down itself (see README).
data_description.presence_sensors: Presence sensors in the leading room. Presence → comfort, even outside the schedule.
data_description.schedule: Schedule helper: on = comfort, off = setback. Rooms without their own schedule follow it. Without schedule and presence the circuit always uses comfort.
data_description.window: Window contact in the leading room. Open longer than the window delay → minimum.
data_description.temp_sensor: Room sensor for the leading room. More accurate than the heat source's own reading.
data_description.pump_switch: Pump of this floor circuit. Runs only once valves are open and the boiler is warm enough.
data_description.source_temp_sensor: Boiler or buffer temperature that releases the floor circuit.
data_description.source_on: The floor pump may run above this boiler temperature.
data_description.source_off: Below this boiler temperature the pump is blocked. Must be below the release.
data_description.valve_delay_s: Wait this long after opening the valves before starting the pump.
data_description.hvac_mode: Vaillant only: zone mode set again after summer. Manual: setpoint directly. Time program: Heating Core sets and renews a quick veto.
data_description.pre_heat_entity: Optional, e.g. for geofencing: while this switch is on, Heating Core pre-heats like the “Pre-heat” button and turns it off after the timeout or once presence/schedule takes over. Empty = only the built-in button.

user.title: Room
user.description: A room belongs to a heating circuit and has either its own thermostat (TRV) or valve channels of a floor heating.

data_description.name: Name of the room, e.g. “Office upstairs”.
data_description.circuit: The circuit the radiator or floor zone is connected to.
data_description.role: Own room: TRV with its own control, raises the circuit if needed. Follows master: TRV takes the circuit's setpoint plus offset. Floor zone: valve channels of a floor circuit.

reconfigure.title: Room
reconfigure.description: A room belongs to a heating circuit and has either its own thermostat (TRV) or valve channels of a floor heating.

data_description.name: Name of the room, e.g. “Office upstairs”.
data_description.circuit: The circuit the radiator or floor zone is connected to.
data_description.role: Own room: TRV with its own control, raises the circuit if needed. Follows master: TRV takes the circuit's setpoint plus offset. Floor zone: valve channels of a floor circuit.

details.title: Room – devices
details.description: Devices of the room. Set comfort on its slider, dashboard or Heating page; setback comes from the circuit.

data_description.climate: The radiator thermostat (TRV) that receives the setpoint.
data_description.valves: Valve channels of this zone; they always switch together.
data_description.offset: Offset to the circuit setpoint, e.g. −2 °C for a cooler bedroom.
data_description.presence_sensors: Presence sensors in the room. Presence → comfort, even outside the schedule.
data_description.schedule: Own schedule for this room only. Empty = the circuit's schedule.
data_description.window: Window contact in the room. Open longer than the window delay → minimum.
data_description.temp_sensor: Own room sensor. More accurate than the sensor inside the thermostat.
data_description.pre_heat_entity: Optional, e.g. for geofencing: while this switch is on, Heating Core pre-heats like the “Pre-heat” button and turns it off after the timeout or once presence/schedule takes over. Empty = only the built-in button.
